for key in medicine-ug medicine-pg medicine-superspeciality dentistry-ug dentistry-pg pharmacy-ug pharmacy-pg pharmacy-diploma nursing-ug nursing-pg physiotherapy-ug paramedical-ug paramedical-pg paramedical-diploma; do
  f=\""'$research_tmp/filter_$key.html"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$key rows ---"
  perl -0777 -ne '"'while(/<tr["'^>]*>(.*?)<'"\\/tr>/gis){"'$r=$1;$r=~s/<[''^>]+>/ /g;$r=~s/&/'"\\&/g;"'$r=~s/'/'"'\"'\"'/g;"'$r=~s/"/"/g;$r=~s/ / /g;$r=~s/'"\\s+/ /g;"'$r=~s/''^ //;$r=~s/ $//; print "$r'"\\n\" if "'$r =~ /Faculty|Medicine|Dentistry|Pharmacy|Nursing|Physiotherapy|Paramedical/;}'"' \""'$f" | tail -n 40
done'
